title: How to Get Structured Output from Any LLM: JSON Schema, Tool Calls, or a Decision Model
excerpt: When your code reads fields from a model's reply, like an order ID or a refund amount, it expects clean JSON every time. Most of the time, it gets it. But now and then the model wraps the JSON in a code fence, adds a field you didn't ask for, or sends a number as text, and your code breaks. If you use several models, one fix won't cover them all, because each model and provider handles structured output in its own way.
